purpose: Source-grounded resource-centered path-sensitive protocol model for the frozen curl V3 twelve-function authoring surface.

EASY_HANDLE.cleanup_obligation: A non-NULL curl_easy_init result creates an easy-handle cleanup obligation.
EASY_HANDLE.release: curl_easy_cleanup on a live detached easy handle releases it.

EXPLICIT_GLOBAL_CLEANUP_OBLIGATION.established_by: successful explicit curl_global_init within the bounded core model

notes: Runtime readiness is distinct from the explicit global-cleanup obligation.
curl_easy_init may establish implicit runtime readiness.
curl_multi_init is not an auto-initialization exception.
The explicit-init-failure state formalizes the frozen rule that a failed explicit curl_global_init does not establish readiness and does not permit subsequent ordinary libcurl use.

MULTI_HANDLE.cleanup_obligation: A non-NULL curl_multi_init result requires corresponding curl_multi_cleanup.

verdict_semantics.UNKNOWN: The available frozen scope/source evidence or bounded representation does not justify VALID or an enforceable violation verdict, including cases whose normative strength is explicitly awaiting independent technical review.
verdict_semantics.VALID: All modeled source-backed preconditions and obligations are satisfied for the analyzed path/state, and no unresolved normative-strength or model-coverage uncertainty controls the result.
verdict_semantics.VIOLATION-MAY: The analysis retains multiple feasible path/state alternatives and at least one violates an enforceable source-backed protocol rule while at least one does not. This verdict expresses path/state uncertainty, not uncertainty about whether a source statement is normative.
verdict_semantics.VIOLATION-MUST: The analyzed path/state definitely violates an enforceable source-backed protocol rule.
